sentence: A shared checklist for a group event where each person can take an open item, mark it done, release it, or add new items, with a progress bar showing how much is covered.
use_when: a group is planning a dinner or party and needs to split up who brings what
people want to see which tasks are still open and claim one
a host wants a simple shared list of food, drinks and setup jobs with owners
friends are sharing chores for a trip or event
dont_use_when: the group needs to vote or pick between options, which needs a poll
the group needs to split a bill or track money owed
someone wants a personal to-do list with no sharing or owners
